functions.tag: {title:'Merlin\'s Journal',author:'Merlin',resolved:1b,generation:3,LoreId:28,pages:['{"text": "Written by a hand that shakes more than it did\\nI have kept no journal in four hundred years. Memory was enough. It is not enough now. The wound in my side takes a little more of me each night, and I would leave something behind that is not a legend."}','{"text": "A hundred winters ago Arthur met Vortigern on the high meadow of Logres, across the western sea. Steel against steel, king against usurper. I watched from the stones. I should have done more than watch."}','{"text": "Vortigern struck a coward\'s blow, and Arthur knew he was dying. If the usurper took the blade, the kingdom was lost. So he did the only thing left to him."}','{"text": "Years before, I had carved a binding ward into the pedestal on that meadow, a precaution, I told myself. Arthur drove Excalibur down into it with the last of his strength."}','{"text": "The ward took the sword, and the king\'s life with it, and froze Vortigern to stone beside him, still reaching."}','{"text": "Vortigern\'s warbands came up the meadow and found their chief turned to stone. They would have had me next. I ran. The old gate on the shore carried me across the water to this side, and I have not been strong enough to open it since."}','{"text": "They never went home. They wait for their chief to wake, and they know I am the only one who remembers how the ward was carved. So they hunt old men in grey cloaks along the roads. They caught me at the marsh chapel."}','{"text": "The brothers there hid me, and I repaid them by bringing the raiders to their door."}','{"text": "This cabin belonged to a woodcutter who did not ask my name. He is gone now, I hope only to his daughter\'s farm. I keep to the upper room. The raiders turn the hall below over every few days, looking for me. They have not found the stair. Not yet."}','{"text": "I ring the bell when the mist is thick. A foolish hope: that someone with a good heart hears it before someone with a blade does. I can no longer heal myself. A healing draught, a golden apple, such small things, and I cannot reach them."}','{"text": "If you are reading this and I am still breathing, wake me. If I am not, find the gate I came through and cross the water. Climb to the meadow. Only one who carries my blessing can draw the sword, and when it leaves the stone, Vortigern wakes."}','{"text": "Be ready."}','{"text": "I have been called prophet and devil, counsellor and fool. Tonight I am only tired. Forgive an old man his doubts. Logres has always been saved by ordinary people who arrived on time. Perhaps you are one., M."}']}
